Structural summary for the merge (#222): currently TWO sibling bordered frames — `agenda-admin-toolbar` (border-ink-4, rounded-md, lines 5198-5257) holding [+ Season] + gear, and `season-manage-panel` (border-ink-5, no rounding, lines 5258-6361) rendered conditionally below it when seasonManageOpen. The gear's aria-controls="season-manage-panel" / the panel's id="season-manage-panel" pairing, aria-expanded, seasonManageGearDisabled, and the focus-return-to-gear (seasonManageGearEl.focus() in closeSeasonManagePanel) all still need to resolve correctly once the DOM nesting changes. No spec pins the computed accessible name (via getByRole(..., {name})) for the gear or the panel the way page.season-manage-whole-field.spec.ts:346-365 does for the whole-field editor button — new coverage for #222 should assert the computed name, not just aria-label truthiness, or a doubled/duplicated-copy regression could ship silently.

claims.claim: Keyboard/roving-tabindex hazard: `handleAdminToolbarKeydown` enumerates ALL descendant `<button>` elements of the toolbar via `toolbar.querySelectorAll('button:not([disabled])')`, not direct children only — if the season-manage-panel (many buttons: add-event, delete confirm/cancel, field-edit pencils, etc.) is nested inside the same `role="toolbar"` element that carries this handler, arrow-key/Home/End presses on ANY panel button will be captured and jump focus across the whole merged subtree, breaking the #213-pinned arity-2 toolbar contract.

This is a subtree query, not scoped to direct children.

claims.claim: Existing regression test `toolbar.querySelectorAll('button')).toHaveLength(2)` does NOT protect against the above hazard, because it only runs against the default (panel-closed) render state.
claims.evidence: page.agenda-admin.spec.ts:652-669, the assertion at :668 runs inside `it('[⚙] and [+ Season] are DIRECT children...')` using plain `renderReady()` with no panel-open step. claims.claim: Correct structure requires a NEW outer 'card' wrapper (border/rounded) holding an inner header-row div (role=toolbar, scoped ONLY to [+Season] + label + gear) and the panel as a sibling of that header row inside the card — not literally extending the existing role="toolbar" div to also contain the panel body.
claims.evidence: Derived directly from the querySelectorAll hazard above plus ARIA authoring-practice concern: role="dialog" content (panel, +page.svelte:5258-5266) nested inside role="toolbar" (whose children are meant to be widgets like buttons) is invalid landmark nesting. claims.claim: Double-border/visual artifact risk: the toolbar row currently carries `rounded-md border border-ink-4 p-1.5` (own frame) and the panel currently carries its own `border border-ink-5 p-3` (own frame) plus `mb-3` — merging into 'one card, no second stacked frame' requires removing/adjusting one of these class sets, not just relocating markup.

sweep.notes:
Read-only sweep against mvox-app on branch feat/221-root-signin-redirect (uncommitted, unrelated #221 work in progress); #222 itself has not been started (no #222 references anywhere in src/). All findings are forward-looking implementation risks for the not-yet-written #222 change, verified by reading the live +page.svelte structure, its supporting a11y helper (src/lib/a11y/roving.ts), the four locale message files, and the existing page.agenda-admin.spec.ts test suite that currently pins the toolbar's DOM shape.

Headline risk (most important, most likely to be missed): handleAdminToolbarKeydown's button query is a full-subtree querySelectorAll, not a direct-children query, and the ONE existing test that would normally catch a scope violation (button count === 2) only runs at default/closed-panel state. A naive 'move the panel's markup inside the existing role=toolbar div' implementation would pass every current test while still breaking keyboard roving the moment the panel is open — exactly the scenario the issue prompt calls out as mandatory to check. The safe structure is: new outer bordered 'card' div > inner header-row div (role=toolbar, scoped to [+Season]/label/gear only) + panel as a sibling of that header row, both inside the new outer card.

Two other genuinely load-bearing, code-verified points: (1) the visible label must live under the SAME `{#if showSeasonManageGear}` gate as the gear itself, not the outer toolbar-mount OR-conditional, to avoid a rights leak for season-create-only callers; (2) no existing test slot exists for a new label testid, so that rights-leak scenario would ship undetected without new coverage.

Sticky/overflow-ancestor hazard, multi-collective state reset, and invite-vs-auto-provisioned rights derivation were all checked and found NOT applicable / unaffected — confidently ruled out rather than left as open questions.

One item (mobile-width wrap behavior for lv/uk) is flagged UNVERIFIABLE from static reading alone since this sub-agent has no browser access — recommend a quick visual check at narrow width in those two locales before merging.
